verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The note does not determine the intermediate-budget boundary analytically or algorithmically: it proves only that the sharp set is the image of a nonconvex three-state program, while effective two-sided certification remains open. The three-state reduction and origin support bound depend on published common-entropy cardinality results, leaving the new causal preservation and diagonal-completion arguments as narrow extensions rather than a broadly reusable identification method. The endpoint and star-kernel theorems constrain the geometry but do not characterize its frontier, and the confidence envelope obtains coverage by unioning the unidentified images over an exact multinomial region without making that envelope computable or informative in size. The framing correctly leaves BH-CERT and contact inference open, but the delivered “exact joint set” is an exact representation rather than an operational solution for intermediate entropy budgets.

DIRECTED IMPROVEMENT (re-derive the SAME object implementing this, do not reproduce the prior note): Replace the non-effective compactness argument with the claimed finite certification procedure, first closing the balanced contact instance and then extending the construction uniformly over the three-state program. The proof must handle zero latent masses and active entropy equality without a local rank assumption.
